n0511aa9cbe.headline: Kazakhstan, Iran Boost Trade and Strategic Ties
n0511aa9cbe.summary: Kazakhstan and Iran are boosting trade and strategic ties, according to The Astana Times. No further details were provided.
n0511aa9cbe.why: Trade links between Central Asian and Middle Eastern economies affect transit routes, energy and commodity flows in the region.

nad73deea91.headline: Markets Today: SNB Hold Rates, SoftBank Falls 7.7%, Gold Slips Post FOMC. DAX Holds Above Psychological 24000 Handle
nad73deea91.summary: The Swiss National Bank held rates, while SoftBank dropped 7.7% and gold slipped following the FOMC. The DAX held above 24,000.
nad73deea91.why: The Swiss National Bank sets Swiss monetary policy, which influences the franc and global risk appetite. SoftBank Group is a Japanese conglomerate with large technology and venture holdings.
nad73deea91.why_moved: SoftBank shares fell 7.7% and gold slipped after the FOMC, according to the market report.

nd36cf28b29.headline: Nigeria remittance sector leaps $23 billion - CAJ News Africa
nd36cf28b29.summary: Nigeria's remittance inflows reached US$23 billion in 2025, the highest level in five years, as digital adoption accelerates, according to Makreo Research.
nd36cf28b29.why: Remittances are a major source of foreign currency for Nigeria, supporting the naira and household consumption. They are closely tracked by investors in African frontier markets.

source.name: CAJ News Africa - Setting Journalism Standards for Africa

sources.name: CAJ News Africa - Setting Journalism Standards for Africa

n7b7f3d181e.headline: Major strike in Portugal disrupts travel and services
n7b7f3d181e.summary: A major strike in Portugal is disrupting travel and services. Portugal has one of the European Union's smallest economies, and its workers are among the lowest paid in the bloc.
n7b7f3d181e.why: Labour strikes can disrupt transport and services and affect economic output in the affected period. They also shape wage negotiations and public-sector costs.

n6238270c42.headline: PZ Cussons to keep Africa business, sets out 'ambitious' growth plans
n6238270c42.summary: PZ Cussons will keep its Africa business and set out ambitious growth plans for it, after failing to receive offers that reflect its inherent value.
n6238270c42.why: PZ Cussons is a UK-listed consumer goods company whose brands include Imperial Leather. Its African operations are a significant part of its emerging-market exposure.

n26cb571985.headline: Swiss National Bank leaves key rate on hold
n26cb571985.summary: The Swiss National Bank left its core policy interest rate unchanged on Thursday, as widely expected.
n26cb571985.why: The Swiss National Bank sets Swiss monetary policy, and its rate decisions influence the Swiss franc, a major safe-haven currency. Holding rates steady signals policy stability.

nd30500d79a.headline: NBU Keeps Key Rate Unchanged Despite Drop in Inflation
nd30500d79a.summary: Ukraine's central bank kept the key rate at 15.5%, citing uncertainty over future foreign financing despite lower inflation. Q3 real GDP data showed some improvement.
nd30500d79a.why: The National Bank of Ukraine sets the policy rate that influences borrowing costs, the hryvnia and the government's financing conditions.

n359ef3fa64.headline: Mixed employment report won't make RBA's job any easier
n359ef3fa64.summary: Unemployment and jobs growth figures for November gave differing signals on the strength of Australia's labour market. The mixed data complicates the central bank's decision-making.
n359ef3fa64.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the country's cash rate, and labour data is a key input for its interest-rate decisions.

nbbaba48fc5.headline: Nasdaq 100: Post-FOMC gains wiped out, but technicals are still bullish
nbbaba48fc5.summary: Nasdaq 100 futures slipped after the FOMC meeting on US-China tensions and AI worries, though improving market breadth kept the medium-term trend intact, according to the analysis.
nbbaba48fc5.why: The Nasdaq 100 tracks the largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq, many of them large technology and AI-linked firms.

impacts.why: The index futures slipped after the FOMC meeting, per the article.

nf6175b3a9d.headline: Today’s Headlines (12/11/25)
nf6175b3a9d.summary: President Trump said US authorities seized a tanker off the coast of Venezuela. Officials have not released details about the vessel, its crew or the reason for the action.
nf6175b3a9d.why: Seizures of oil tankers near Venezuela affect crude export flows from a major oil producer and the broader Caribbean oil trade.

n3084379101.headline: Germany news: Economic institutes slash 2026 growth forecast
n3084379101.summary: Three German research institutes forecast a slowdown in economic growth for 2026, according to the report. Chancellor Merz has called for a stronger European role in NATO.
n3084379101.why: Germany is the euro area's largest economy, so its growth outlook influences European markets and the euro.

na8efe4015f.headline: Weight loss drugs could get cheaper from next year
na8efe4015f.summary: The Australian government is considering expanding taxpayer subsidies for Ozempic-style drugs, which could make them cheaper from next year. Concerns about possible side effects were noted.
na8efe4015f.why: Government subsidies for weight-loss drugs affect pricing and volume for pharmaceutical makers that sell these medicines.

n4916618ede.headline: Today’s Headlines (12/11/25)
n4916618ede.summary: President Trump said US authorities seized a tanker off Venezuela's coast as relations with Caracas remain tense. Officials have not released details about the vessel, its crew or the reason.
n4916618ede.why: Venezuela holds large crude reserves, and US sanctions and maritime actions around its oil exports affect global crude supply and tanker flows.

n2479c2a349.headline: EU ready to isolate Belgium if it does not support loan for Ukraine – media
n2479c2a349.summary: The EU is ramping up pressure on Belgium, which continues to block efforts to provide Ukraine with a revolving loan, Politico reported.
n2479c2a349.why: Financing for Ukraine involves EU budget and frozen Russian assets, so disputes among member states affect Ukraine's funding and EU policy cohesion.

n5289543c92.headline: Myer hails Black Friday boom as top label nears return
n5289543c92.summary: Department store Myer recorded its biggest Black Friday sale performance on record as it prepares to relaunch a top label. Further details were not provided in the description.
n5289543c92.why: Myer is an Australian department store retailer, and holiday-season sales are a key indicator of its earnings and consumer demand.

n8a2b3b2ff2.headline: Momentum in SA markets continues with Fed cut
n8a2b3b2ff2.summary: The rand, South African bonds and equities gained as domestic reforms and global policy, including a Fed rate cut, boosted sentiment.
n8a2b3b2ff2.why: The rand and local bonds and equities respond to global interest-rate shifts and domestic policy, shaping returns for investors in South Africa.
n8a2b3b2ff2.why_moved: Domestic reforms and global policy, including a US Federal Reserve rate cut, boosted investor sentiment toward South African assets.

neaebcb3377.headline: KZN treasury injects R193m to ease spiralling debt to municipalities
neaebcb3377.summary: The KwaZulu-Natal provincial treasury injected R193 million to ease mounting debt owed to municipalities, offering temporary relief to departments facing rates arrears.
neaebcb3377.why: Provincial finances and municipal payment arrears affect local government credit, service delivery and infrastructure spending in South Africa.

n7da00607f0.headline: Kogi asks residents to embrace upcoming tax changes
n7da00607f0.summary: The Kogi state government has urged residents to comply with the modified federal tax system, which takes effect on January 1.
n7da00607f0.why: Nigeria's tax reforms affect businesses, household incomes and government revenue collection across the country's states.

nd2c3224b1c.headline: SA Reits smash past R300bn as sector posts strongest gains since 2019
nd2c3224b1c.summary: Listed South African property companies (REITs) have a combined market value above R300bn, posting their strongest sector gains since 2019 on dividend and price increases.
nd2c3224b1c.why: Real estate investment trusts pay out most of their income as dividends and are sensitive to interest rates and the property market.

n4ba00f679d.headline: Not this bleak since the pandemic
n4ba00f679d.summary: A Gallup survey for the Central Bank of Iceland and the Confederation of Icelandic Enterprise found sentiment has turned markedly worse. 54% of respondents describe economic conditions as poor.
n4ba00f679d.why: Business and consumer sentiment surveys are leading indicators of spending and investment, and they inform central-bank policy in small open economies.

n0071fc7611.headline: U.S. to impose tariffs on Nicaragua goods over labor ‘abuses’
n0071fc7611.summary: The US said it will impose new tariffs on certain Nicaraguan goods starting in 2027. The measure follows findings of labour and human rights abuses.
n0071fc7611.why: Nicaragua's exports are concentrated in a few goods sold to the US, so US tariffs directly affect its trade flows and investor sentiment.

n882a6c1c4f.headline: UAE Telecom Giant e& to Pilot Dirham Stablecoin for Consumer Payments
n882a6c1c4f.summary: UAE telecom group e& is preparing to test a regulated stablecoin for everyday consumer payments. It has teamed up with Al Maryah Community Bank to pilot the AE Coin stablecoin.
n882a6c1c4f.why: e& is a major Gulf telecom operator, and its move into stablecoin payments reflects the UAE's push for blockchain-based financial infrastructure.

ne01951a4d2.headline: Trump says the U.S. has seized an oil tanker off the coast of Venezuela
ne01951a4d2.summary: Trump said U.S. forces seized an oil tanker off the coast of Venezuela. The move is an unusual use of U.S. forces to take control of a merchant ship and raises pressure on Maduro, who has been charged with narcoterrorism.
ne01951a4d2.why: Venezuela holds some of the world's largest proven oil reserves, and U.S. sanctions and enforcement actions affect its crude exports. Shipping disruptions can move global oil flows and tanker markets.

ne716ecfe90.headline: Motorway tolls in Spain to rise again above inflation, another 4% from 1 January
ne716ecfe90.summary: Motorway tolls in Spain will rise another 4% from 1 January, above inflation. The central government continues compensating concessionaires for a 2023 tariff limit tied to the economic crisis.
ne716ecfe90.why: Toll concessions are long-term infrastructure contracts, and government compensation mechanisms affect the revenues of motorway operators.

n4984b8aa76.headline: ADNOC Distribution adopts AE Coin payments across its retail network
n4984b8aa76.summary: ADNOC Distribution has adopted AE Coin payments across its retail network. The announcement is framed as support for the UAE's digital transformation.
n4984b8aa76.why: ADNOC Distribution is the fuel retail arm of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, operating a large network of service stations in the UAE.

n87aab377e4.headline: Coca-Cola names new CEO, Henrique Braun to lead company as James Quincey steps down amid tepid demand | Company Business News
n87aab377e4.summary: Coca-Cola has named Henrique Braun as chief executive, succeeding James Quincey, who is stepping down. The change comes as packaged food companies adjust strategies amid tepid demand.
n87aab377e4.why: Coca-Cola is one of the world's largest beverage companies, and leadership changes shape its strategy on pricing, portfolio and growth.

impacts.name: Coca-Cola
impacts.why: A new chief executive takes over as the company faces tepid demand and shifting consumer preferences.

n95f6209fe0.summary: ABSolar says solar additions may fall 24% to 10.6 GW in 2026 from 15 GW in 2024. Regulatory barriers, high capital costs and restricted self-generation access are slowing investment.
n95f6209fe0.why: Solar capacity additions show how quickly a country's power supply is growing. Investment in solar is shaped by regulation, financing costs and grid access.

n1db560be46.summary: London stocks edged lower in early trade as investors weighed disappointing Oracle earnings and the Federal Reserve's rate cut, which signalled a long pause ahead. The move was modest.
n1db560be46.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of large UK-listed companies, and it is sensitive to global rate policy and US tech results.

nd57a077aea.summary: The Indian rupee fell 39 paise to close at a record low of 90.33 per US dollar on Thursday. The decline is attributed to uncertainty over the India-US trade deal and sustained foreign fund outflows.
nd57a077aea.why: The rupee is India's currency, and its value affects import costs, inflation and foreign investor returns. Trade negotiations and capital flows are key drivers of the rupee's exchange rate.

n02037fff65.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of the largest London-listed companies. Federal Reserve decisions shape global interest rates, and Oracle is a large US enterprise software and cloud company.

nbb404188eb.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the country's cash rate, and labour market data is a key input into its interest rate decisions.

n8f2c672ec1.headline: Dangote to offer dollar-denominated dividends for refinery IPO
n8f2c672ec1.summary: Aliko Dangote unveiled plans for the Dangote Refinery IPO, offering shareholders dollar-denominated dividends intended to hedge against currency volatility.
n8f2c672ec1.why: Dangote Refinery is a large Nigerian oil refinery, and its listing would be a major test of investor appetite for Nigerian energy assets.

n75c86e3431.headline: Paris Stocks Edge Higher Following Wall Street Gains After Fed Decision
n75c86e3431.summary: The Paris stock exchange opened slightly higher on Thursday, following Wall Street's rally after the US Federal Reserve decided to continue its cycle of interest rate cuts.
n75c86e3431.why: The CAC 40 is the benchmark index of large French listed companies, and Federal Reserve decisions shape global risk sentiment and borrowing costs.

n61a220acc8.headline: Tax reform call as data centre boom plugs in investment
n61a220acc8.summary: A jump in forecast business investment in the midyear budget update will be unveiled by the treasurer. Data centre investment is driving the boom, and calls for tax reform have followed.
n61a220acc8.why: Business investment is a key driver of Australian GDP growth, and the federal budget update shapes fiscal and economic expectations.

n71748d733e.headline: Bids for offshore drilling doubled in value. That means big money for Louisiana’s coast.
n71748d733e.summary: Bids for offshore drilling leases doubled in value as the Trump administration opens far more leases than the Biden administration did, according to The Advocate.
n71748d733e.why: Offshore leases determine future oil and gas production in US federal waters. Higher lease activity signals greater upstream investment.

n194285b34e.headline: Competing health care plans fail in the Senate as ACA premium hikes loom
n194285b34e.summary: Competing Democratic and Republican health care bills failed in the Senate, as Congress faces pressure before federal subsidies lapse at year-end and premiums rise.
n194285b34e.why: Federal subsidies for Affordable Care Act plans affect insurance premiums paid by millions of Americans and the costs faced by insurers and health providers.

n8b4984896f.headline: Budget uncertainty weighs heavily on housing market - Rics
n8b4984896f.summary: The UK housing market remained subdued in November, a closely watched survey showed. Pre-Budget jitters weighed on confidence.
n8b4984896f.why: The RICS survey tracks surveyor reports on house prices and sales, a leading indicator for UK housing activity and mortgage and property-related investments.

n7c3f19758c.headline: Burger King announces 30 new restaurants in UK in 2026
n7c3f19758c.summary: Burger King said it will open 30 new restaurants in the UK in 2026 as it continues its expansion programme. The brand currently has 574 UK restaurants.
n7c3f19758c.why: Burger King is a global fast-food chain, and its restaurant expansion reflects growth in quick-service dining and franchise economics.

n87fbae68ec.headline: Firstgroup buys RATP's UK sightseeing bus operations in £17m deal
n87fbae68ec.summary: FirstGroup said it acquired the UK sightseeing bus operations of RATP Développement for roughly £17m. The deal is part of an effort to grow and diversify its First Bus business in two key markets.
n87fbae68ec.why: FirstGroup is a UK-based public transport operator running bus and rail services, so its acquisitions shape its growth and diversification strategy.

n6810d74a68.headline: Thursday newspaper round-up: Youth employment, SpaceX, EY
n6810d74a68.summary: A PwC report says Britain is slipping in global youth employment rankings, with regional divisions costing the economy £26bn a year.
n6810d74a68.why: Youth labour market weakness can weigh on future productivity and tax receipts, which matters for UK growth forecasts.

n2930cc1902.summary: More than $100bn has been wiped off Oracle's market value over fears that its AI bet is failing to pay off.
n2930cc1902.why: Oracle is a large enterprise software and cloud infrastructure company, and its AI spending is closely watched by investors.

n3cc49cbbad.summary: November unemployment and jobs growth figures tell differing stories about the strength of Australia's labour market, complicating the central bank's task.
n3cc49cbbad.why: Employment data are a key input for the Reserve Bank of Australia when setting interest rates.

nee888f0ce0.headline: Trump Tells US Shoppers to 'Give Up Pencils, They Only Need One or Two' as He Defends New Import Taxes
nee888f0ce0.summary: In a Pennsylvania speech, Donald Trump defended his tariff policies and said higher prices on imports are a trade-off for a stronger steel industry. He suggested Americans do not need as many pencils or dolls.
nee888f0ce0.why: Tariffs on imports affect consumer prices, supply chains and trade relations, and they are a central policy lever for US trade and industrial strategy.

ne70ff46fb3.headline: 'Epic fraud': crypto mogul jailed over $40b collapse
ne70ff46fb3.summary: Crypto entrepreneur Do Kwon has been sentenced to 15 years in prison after a collapse described as a $US40 billion crash that revealed what was called epic fraud.
ne70ff46fb3.why: Do Kwon founded Terraform Labs, whose stablecoin and token collapse in 2022 wiped out large amounts of value and reshaped crypto regulation debates.

n805fdae9a8.headline: TerraUSD creator Do Kwon sentenced to 15 years over US$40 billion crypto collapse
n805fdae9a8.summary: Do Kwon, creator of TerraUSD, was sentenced to 15 years after pleading guilty in August to conspiracy to defraud and wire fraud. The case concerns a US$40 billion crypto collapse.
n805fdae9a8.why: The TerraUSD stablecoin and LUNA token collapse in 2022 wiped out tens of billions of dollars and prompted tighter scrutiny of stablecoins.

n243845dad5.headline: In stunning reversal for Europe, Greek finance minister elected as Eurogroup president
n243845dad5.summary: Greek Finance Minister Kyriakos Pierrakakis has been elected president of the Eurogroup. The move comes a decade after Greece's deep financial crisis, which nearly led to its exit from the eurozone.
n243845dad5.why: The Eurogroup brings together eurozone finance ministers and coordinates fiscal and economic policy for the currency bloc. Its president sets the agenda on bailouts, budgets and eurozone governance.

n0fb29ddccc.summary: European stock futures edged lower and Asian benchmarks were mixed as the dollar and Treasury yields moved, following a fractured Federal Reserve vote. No major economic indicators were scheduled.

n9a98331d5e.headline: Drax sees earnings at top end; Could start data centre by 2027
n9a98331d5e.summary: Drax said it expected full-year earnings at the top end of consensus estimates. It said it could convert existing infrastructure at its North Yorkshire plant to run a data centre as soon as 2027.
n9a98331d5e.why: Drax is a UK power generator that operates the large Drax Power Station in North Yorkshire and has been shifting its business toward biomass and flexible generation.

n1a62e21702.headline: Bitcoin dips below $90,000 as AI worries dent risk appetite
n1a62e21702.summary: Bitcoin fell below $90,000 on Thursday and dragged other cryptocurrencies lower. The fall followed fresh market worries about AI profits and weaker risk appetite after a US cloud firm's results.
n1a62e21702.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value and often trades as a high-risk asset, so it tends to react to shifts in broader risk sentiment.
n1a62e21702.why_moved: Fresh worries about AI profitability reduced risk appetite after a US cloud firm's results, and bitcoin fell below $90,000 and pulled other cryptocurrencies lower.

n6abc9ae41f.headline: What’s up with… Ciena, T-Mobile US, IPOs
n6abc9ae41f.summary: Ciena predicts at least 20% sales growth for 2026, according to a TelecomTV roundup. The roundup also covers T-Mobile US appointing a new COO and IPO speculation around Jio and SpaceX.
n6abc9ae41f.why: Ciena supplies optical networking equipment used by telecom and cloud operators. Its outlook is a read-through for demand in network infrastructure.

n3f5ac88484.headline: Automaker gears up for self-driving future with new chip
n3f5ac88484.summary: Rivian announced a breakthrough autonomy chip and a subscription service for hands-free driving across 3.5 million miles of roads, starting in early 2026.
n3f5ac88484.why: Rivian is a US electric vehicle maker, and its autonomous driving push is a bid to add recurring software revenue to its vehicle sales.

na44bad5f4b.headline: Amount Canadians owe relative to income continued to tick higher in third quarter
na44bad5f4b.summary: Statistics Canada says household credit market debt relative to disposable income rose to 176.7% in the third quarter, from 176.3% in the second, a fourth straight quarterly increase.
na44bad5f4b.why: Household debt levels shape consumer spending, mortgage risk and the Bank of Canada's interest rate decisions.

nf4821b6650.headline: 'Not what they're saying': Carney rejects suggestion U.S. may exit trade pact
nf4821b6650.summary: Carney pushed back on suggestions that the United States may be considering pulling out of the trilateral North American free-trade agreement.
nf4821b6650.why: The North American free-trade pact governs much of the trade between Canada, the US and Mexico, so its future affects many sectors and currencies.
